title: Deterministic linear chirp initialization across discovered thickness extremes
scientific_hypothesis: Initializing layer thicknesses with a deterministic linear chirp spanning 60-159 nm (the extremes discovered in route_02) will enable the optimizer to converge faster and achieve higher target scores compared to stochastic perturbation around 100 nm, because the initial state already occupies the productive thickness configuration space.
design_principle: Linear optical thickness gradient across the stack creates progressively shifting Bragg conditions that broaden the high-reflection band in the visible while maintaining transmission windows in the NIR telecom band.
proposed_topology: 30 finite layers, alternating HfO2/SiO2 starting with HfO2 at air interface: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica
design_variables: All 30 layer thicknesses (nm), initialized with linear chirp from 60 nm to 159 nm
manufacturing_considerations: Thickness range 60-159 nm is within typical deposition control capability
Alternating binary material system simplifies process control
theory_basis: Transfer-matrix method for laterally uniform linear isotropic layered media
Chirped multilayer theory for broadband reflection: varying optical thickness shifts local Bragg condition across the stack
Prior iteration route_02 discovered productive thickness range 60-159 nm through optimization
expected_advantages: Deterministic initialization reduces optimizer search space
Linear chirp provides smooth spectral transition
Directly leverages empirical thickness extremes from route_02
known_risks: Linear chirp may not be optimal profile shape
May still require significant optimization iterations
Performance may plateau near route_02 best score if chirp profile is suboptimal
execution_request_english: Optimize a 30-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 multilayer coating on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2(1), SiO2(2), HfO2(3), SiO2(4), HfO2(5), SiO2(6), HfO2(7), SiO2(8), HfO2(9), SiO2(10), HfO2(11), SiO2(12), HfO2(13), SiO2(14), HfO2(15), SiO2(16), HfO2(17), SiO2(18), HfO2(19), SiO2(20), HfO2(21), SiO2(22), HfO2(23), SiO2(24), HfO2(25), SiO2(26), HfO2(27), SiO2(28), HfO2(29), SiO2(30). Initialize all 30 thicknesses with deterministic linear chirp: layer 1 = 60 nm, layer 30 = 159 nm, intermediate layers linearly interpolated. All thicknesses are optimizable variables with bounds [40 nm, 180 nm]. Optimize for maximum transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band and maximum reflectance in 400-700 nm band. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer. Evaluate at normal incidence (0 degrees), unpolarized or both TE/TM. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates, tightest_margin, thicknesses_nm for all candidates. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 400-700 nm, 1530-1565 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1530–1565 nm; high reflection in 400–700 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: reflection in 1530–1565 nm; transmission in 400–700 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count not exceeding 30.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive to switch from stochastic 100 nm initialization to deterministic linear chirp spanning 60-159 nm thickness extremes discovered in route_02. This targets the exact productive configuration space identified in prior iteration.
